gloss: close to station; near the station

definitions.gloss: close to station; near the station; within walking distance of a train station
definitions.explanation: describes a location, usually a property or business, that is conveniently close to a train or subway station; a key selling point in Japanese real estate

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property close to the station.

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Rent is expensive for places near the station.

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in a convenient location near the station.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station) + {近|ちか} (near, close) → close to station
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧ (close to the station) → abbreviated to {駅近|えきちか}

USAGE:
A real-estate and advertising word. There is no fixed definition, but listings generally use {駅近|えきちか} for places within roughly a ten-minute walk (駅⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧10{分|ぷん}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧), and such places command higher rents.
